Profile.source: CapFrameX validation: Streamline was already loaded at attach and exposed no authoritative creation queue; bypass vendor proxy/status hooks and draw on native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues

CapFrameX validation: Streamline was already loaded at attach and its pass-through proxy exposed no authoritative creation queue; bypass vendor proxy/status hooks and draw on native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues

CapFrameX validation: the late-attached XeSS-FG proxy remained in synchronous pass-through mode without an authoritative context or initialization queue; bypass vendor proxy/status hooks and draw on native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues

CapFrameX validation and RTSS 7.3.7 routing model: hook native DXGI Present plus observed DIRECT command queues only; do not hook Streamline, XeSS-FG or FidelityFX control/proxy paths; the temporary startup swapchain must be released without the shared DXGI Release hook
CapFrameX validation and RTSS NVPresent routing model: inject when D3D12 is mapped, bypass Streamline proxy rendering, and draw on eligible native DXGI Presents using observed DIRECT command queues

CapFrameX validation and RTSS routing model: inject after D3D12 is mapped, use native DXGI Present plus observed DIRECT command queues instead of vendor proxy/status hooks, and disable the D3D11-only shared Release hook because Steam's DXGI interposer re-enters it
